overall: The AG found the subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a January 30 notice that listed only executive session, omitting the open session where it elected its chair and voted to enter executive session. Ordered immediate and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Notice of the January 30 meeting did not state that the subcommittee would meet in open session before convening in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: As the Subcommittee failed to post notice that it would meet in open session to elect its chair and to follow proper procedure to convene in executive session, it violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Notice did not indicate that the election of a chair would occur in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Notice also should have indicated that election of the chair would occur in open session.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Subcommittee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
